assertions.name: recorded against the source under test
recorded against the live API and worker images
the recorder applies the redaction rule the controls test
OCR read text from every sampled frame
no password, account name, e-mail address, JWT or API key is readable in any sampled frame
every caption and its step header is legible in the video
positive control: the planted e-mail and password are found in every sampled frame
assertions.expected: password:decoy and email:decoy in all frames

assertions.name: positive control: the planted password is rendered unmasked
redaction control: the password input holds the decoy but stays masked
redaction control: the same planted values are unreadable in every sampled frame
anonymously downloaded bytes equal the verified file
the downloaded copy decodes end to end without errors at the verified duration

artifacts.description: Recorder timeline: captions, speed-ups, steps, bound deployment, output checksum
OCR text (whole frame plus overlapping tiles) of every sampled frame; matches redacted before writing
Positive control frame: decoy credentials visible
Redaction control frame: same decoy credentials under the recorder's redaction
E-mail field of both panes during sign-in, 3x, for visual review
E-mail field of both panes while the right pane re-signs in as Valley, 3x, for visual review
Signed-in account footer of both panes across the video, 3x, for visual review
Twelve evenly spaced frames from the published video
